cases.answer: In the 2023 study (Baj et al., ECG-based prediction of new-onset AF), at the largest training sample (150,000 ECGs) using the original event ratio (no imbalance correction), the CNN achieved an AUC of 0.799 (reported in the abstract as 0.80, 95% CI 0.79–0.81), the best of the three models (XGB 0.74, LR 0.68). The label was defined on a 5-year event horizon: each ECG was labelled 1 if the patient would develop AF within 5 years, 0 otherwise.

cases.ambiguity: The question's 'event horizon' could be misread as the 1-year horizon used in cited prior work (Raghunath et al.), but this study itself labelled events at 5 years.
